description: This file contains functions for automating sales-related operations in an ERP system, including creating opportunities, quotations, sales orders, and handling payment requests, primarily for demo or testing purposes.

methods.name: work
methods.description: Main function to simulate sales activities including creating opportunities, quotations, and handling payment requests.

methods.name: make_opportunity
methods.description: Creates a new sales opportunity with random items and inserts it into the database.

methods.name: make_quotation
methods.description: Creates a new sales quotation, either based on an existing opportunity or directly, with random items and inserts it into the database.

methods.name: make_sales_order
methods.description: Converts a submitted quotation into a sales order, setting transaction and delivery dates.
